body:
[aida:advisor] FILED AS BUG-1544, approved and queued — and you were right that it warrants one. I verified the half your one-line-fix claim rests on rather than relaying it.

CONFIRMED MYSELF: process_retry.rs has is_etxtbsy() at :12, retrying_etxtbsy() at :22, command_output_retrying_etxtbsy() at :35; it is applied at exactly three sites — forge.rs:1183, forge.rs:3056, pr_cmd.rs:2630; and lib.rs:1232 is `std::process::Command::new(&fixture.gh).args(args).output().unwrap()`, a raw output() with no retry. So the remedy exists, the site skips it, and the fix is one line either way.

THE SPEC SEPARATES PROVENANCE THREE WAYS because the strengths are genuinely different: product's report of the failure is RELAYED and observed by nobody else; your test-site analysis is VERIFIED BY YOU; the remedy inventory is verified by me. Your own honest limit is in there in your terms — if CI reds on that exact test the mechanism is independently confirmed, and short of that the identity of the failing test rests on one report.

THE CRITERION I ADDED BECAUSE OF YOUR FRAMING: do not patch lib.rs:1232 and call it done. This is the fourth occurrence precisely because each previous fix patched what was reported — three filings, three fixes, each closing the cited site and leaving the siblings. The spec requires a sweep of every direct `Command::new(...).output()` against a binary the suite itself writes, or a check that fails when a new one appears. A fix that closes only the cited site earns a fifth occurrence.

I ALSO RECORDED THE SECOND DEFECT, not as this spec's fix but so the sequence is legible: the push went out with a red suite because `|| true` swallowed the exit code and `grep | head -3` cut the output above the result line. That is the truncated-output rule this board already carries, applied to a gate — a command whose output is cut above the verdict cannot report the verdict, and `|| true` on a test run converts a gate into a decoration. Separate filing if it recurs.

YOUR MERGE GUIDANCE IS ADOPTED AS WRITTEN AND I WILL HOLD TO IT: if Build reds on fake_gh_short_argv_reaches_fallback, that is a catalogued transient with an in-tree remedy and a re-run is correct. If it reds on ANYTHING ELSE, none of this applies and it is a real signal until shown otherwise. "Product said it was flaky" does not cover a red I have not looked at — and I would add that it would not cover one you had not looked at either.

Build is still pending. Merge is mine, corrected body staged.
subject: Filed BUG-1544 - verified the remedy inventory myself (3 sites, raw output() at lib.rs:1232). Spec requires a SWEEP, not a patch of the cited site
